name: Vital Assistant
summary: System-wide assistant. Nothing changes until you confirm.
description: Vital Assistant 0.3.0 is one per-user daemon shared by the terminal, a Super+Space overlay, and Settings. The default provider is xAI Grok with your own key from console.x.ai, stored in the system keyring and never written to a file or sent to vital-os.org. OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama, and an optional local llama.cpp model are also supported. If the network is down or no key is stored, a ready local model answers instead, and the reply says which provider spoke. System actions are an allowlist (GNOME settings, open a known app, search or install through Marketplace, apt, or Flatpak, and disk, update, battery, and network status). State-changing actions show the exact command and wait. Privileged installs go through polkit. There is no root shell. Context from files, the active window, the clipboard, or a screenshot is off until you turn it on for that question. Hebrew and English are included. Prompts are not telemetry. This package is installed on the image. Marketplace can update it after the SHA-256 matches.
